description: POST https://api.dmca.com/updateCase — update managed takedown case. Status and priority are kept as they are unless you pass them. Uses the session/`token` DMCA API token.

priority.description: Optional new priority. Left unchanged when omitted.

status.description: Optional new case status. Left unchanged when omitted.

token.description: DMCA API token from the login tool; optional if the server/session already has one.

name: updateCase
